descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your own train set, as big as you want it - now in three rooms.

THREE ROOMS
Pick a room from the start menu, the pause menu or the build wheel and the whole room changes around your layout in one instant. KIDS ROOM: bright colours, bunting, toys and a play mat. MODERN ROOM: a calm, stylish grown-up lounge. GARDEN: your railway outdoors on a mown lawn under a blue sky, with a picket fence, flower beds, sunflowers, a lily pond, a shed and trees all round. Your trains keep running while you switch.

BUILD
Press Y to open the round build wheel. Pick a straight, a turn, an S-curve, a hill or a climbing curve and aim it at the end of your line - it snaps on perfectly. Build loops and mountain railways that climb up and come back down.

TRAINS AND WAGONS
12 ready-to-run trains: puffing steam engines, a bullet train, city trains, a metro, a subway, freight trains and a tram. Aim a wagon at the back of a train and it couples on.

DRIVE
Point at any train and take the controls: trigger to go, brake with the other hand, back up at the end of the line. Blow the whistle and pull into the station for ALL ABOARD. Take a tight turn too fast and your train comes off the rails.

A LIVING RAILWAY
The other trains drive themselves: slowing for curves, waiting at stations, keeping a safe gap.

Also: stations, tunnels, signals, trees and a spinning windmill, three ready-made layouts, undo, auto-save, and music.

Developed and published by Citiview Studios.
